The Verses of the Elder Nandaka:
who belongs to the faction of Māra and is lustful!
There are nine streams in your body that flow at all times;
do not think of them as old.
They have placed their trust in the Tathāgata;
they do not take delight even in heaven,
so how much less in the human world?
But those who are fools, of poor intelligence,
they are the ones who become attached there.
In the prison cast by Māra,
and ignorance have been faded away—
“Such persons do not become attached there;
their threads are cut, they are without bonds.
